name: SkewedMarquee
description: An invented agent shop built from skewed marquee bands that run without any JavaScript
intent: Infinite marquee bands thrown across the page at an angle, with no JavaScript in the animation at all. The whole motion system is CSS, which is the thing worth taking from it.
